motivation: The maximum-hardware-volume series passed timing but clipped intermittently and non-monotonically across -12 dB and -18 dB software gains. Aggregate clipping could not identify whether peaks occurred during actual file playback or the trailing quiet capture interval.
required_instrumentation_before_run: actual playback-process-active state distinct from the session-level stimulus-present tag
audit equality between summed frame clipped samples and aggregate clipped samples

interpretation_rule: If all gates pass, natural-speech timing is supported only at the new 50-percent hardware setting; the earlier maximum-volume failure remains retained. If clipping recurs, report whether it falls in actual playback or trailing quiet, retain the failure, and stop without another volume or gain change.
claim_boundary: One already-spent adult IDS utterance, approximate knob position rather than calibrated SPL, fixed room/geometry, one XVF3800 and M4 Pro host. This diagnostic cannot establish semantic/register performance, general natural-speech robustness, calibrated acoustic level, geometry transfer, or XMOS internal latency.
